title: Northwind Studio: how booking requests are handled, as the office manager keeps it

tasks.name: Handle the pending booking requests
tasks.summary: Grant or refuse every booking request that is waiting, and tell the person who asked what was decided.
tasks.input: The pending requests the booking system lists (list_pending); each request's details come from get_request.
tasks.done: Every request that was pending has been granted or refused, and the person who asked has been told what was decided.
tasks.failed: A request is left pending without a reason, or the report says something that is not so.
quality: Correct before fast: a decision is final once it is recorded.
A decision rests on the booking rules in force, as the domain model gives them now.
tasks.mandate: You grant or refuse alone, request by request. You do not change a rule.
tasks.scope: Pending requests in the booking system. A request about anything else is outside this task: say so.

plans.name: Look at the room kind before the hours
plans.when: You are about to decide a request.
steps: Read the request's room kind, then the rules for that kind in the domain model, then compare the hours.
plans.why: The limit depends on the kind of room, so the hours alone say nothing.
plans.adapt: Any order that gets you to the right rule.
